name: Simple Chat App
author: sayem78

sections.description:
Easily add a floating WhatsApp chat button to your WordPress site. Let your visitors contact you directly via WhatsApp with a single click. Admins can set the WhatsApp number and customize the button color from the settings page.

Features:
* Floating WhatsApp chat button on all pages
* Admin can set WhatsApp number and country code
* Button color is fully customizable
* Uses official WhatsApp wa.me service
* Lightweight and easy to use
* No coding required
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/simple-chat-app directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to ‘Settings’ > ‘Simple Chat App’ to configure your WhatsApp number and button color.
sections.faq:
Can I use a custom color for the chat button?

Yes, you can pick any color from the settings page using the color picker.

Does this plugin store any chat history?

No, this plugin only provides a direct link to WhatsApp. No chat history is stored on your site.

Can I use this for multiple WhatsApp numbers?

No, the plugin currently supports one WhatsApp number at a time.
